name: NISON_CONTEXT_BRIDGE_V1
purpose: Supply market context to Nison without redefining Nison patterns or allowing Nison to create direction.
source_principles: Nison candlesticks must be read in market context and with confluence.
Murphy defines directional context from successive market peaks and troughs.
critical_boundary: The bridge supplies context evidence; it does not turn context into a trade direction and does not replace the Nison source rule.
availability_policy: Nison may consume context only at the upstream Market Structure availability timestamp.
